notes.content:
We're thrilled to introduce the Endless Mode. Now, you can enjoy an endless challenge, pushing your skills to the limit as you progress through never-ending sieges. This mode allows you to play without limits, competing for resist and setting new records.

Are you ready for this endless challenge? Update now and show how far you can go!
